tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description:
List tasks from TickTick.

Retrieves tasks from a specific project or all projects. Use 'status' to
filter by active/completed tasks. For completed tasks across all projects,
omit the project parameter.

project.description:
Project name or ID to list tasks from. Supports fuzzy matching.
Use "inbox" for the default inbox. Omit to list from all projects.

limit.description: Maximum number of completed tasks to return (only used with status="completed").

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get a single task by its ID.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Create a new task in TickTick.

project.description: Project name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching. Omit for inbox.

start.description: Start date. Same format as due. If duration is set, defaults to due.

duration.description: Duration like "1h", "30m", "1h30m". Requires a start or due date with a time.

tags.description: List of tag names to apply.

all_day.description: Whether this is an all-day task. Auto-detected from date format.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. "America/Chicago"). Defaults to system timezone.

column.description: Kanban column name or ID to put the task in. Requires project.

reminders.description:
Reminder triggers, e.g. ["TRIGGER:PT0S"] (at due time) or
["TRIGGER:-PT15M"] (15 min before). Omit to get the default when the task
has a date: at the due time for timed tasks, 9am for all-day tasks. Pass
[] for no reminder.

tools.name: edit_task
tools.description:
Update an existing task.

Only provided fields are changed. Use clear_due/clear_start to remove dates.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tags.description: Replace all tags with this list.

clear_due.description: Set to true to remove the due date.

clear_start.description: Set to true to remove the start date.

column.description: Move the task to this kanban column (name or ID) within its project.

reminders.description:
Replace all reminders with these triggers, e.g. ["TRIGGER:PT0S"].
Pass [] to remove all reminders. Omit to leave reminders unchanged.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description:
Mark one or more tasks as complete.

Pass `task_id` for a single task, or `task_ids` for several. Several tasks are
completed with the batch endpoint in chunks of 50 instead of one request each.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task(s).

task_id.description: A single task ID to complete.

task_ids.description: Several task IDs to complete (all in `project`).

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description:
Permanently delete a task.

This action cannot be undone. The task is moved to trash first but
this API call removes it entirely.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: Move a task from one project to another.

tools.name: assign_task
tools.description:
Assign a task to a member of its (shared) project.

Use list_project_members to find valid usernames. Only works in
projects shared with other people.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tools.name: unassign_task
tools.description: Remove the assignee from a task.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tools.name: set_subtask
tools.description:
Make a task a subtask of another task.

Both tasks must be in the same project.

task_id.description: The task ID to make a subtask.

project.description: The project name or ID containing both tasks.

tools.name: unparent_task
tools.description: Remove a task's parent, making it a top-level task.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tools.name: list_trash
tools.description:
List tasks in the trash.

Returns tasks that have been deleted but not yet permanently removed.
Requires v2 session token.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on a task.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description:
Add a comment to a task.

Comments cannot be edited through the official API. To change one,
delete it and add a new one.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment from a task.

project.description: The project name or ID containing the task.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description:
List all projects (task lists) in TickTick.

Returns all projects including their IDs, names, colors, and folder assignments.
Does not include the Inbox — use "inbox" as the project name in task tools to
interact with the default inbox.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description:
Get a single project by name or ID.

Supports fuzzy name matching. Use "inbox" to get the inbox project.

project.description: Project name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: list_project_members
tools.description:
List the members of a project.

Returns username, displayName, and self (true for you). A project
that is not shared lists only you. Use a member's username with
assign_task.

project.description: Project name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: add_project
tools.description: Create a new project (task list).

folder.description: Folder name or ID to place the project in.

tools.name: edit_project
tools.description:
Update an existing project's properties.

Only provided fields are changed.

project.description: Project name or ID to edit.

folder.description: Move project to this folder (name or ID).

remove_folder.description: Set to true to remove the project from its folder.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description:
Permanently delete a project and all its tasks.

This action cannot be undone.

project.description: Project name or ID to delete.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description:
Search tasks by keyword, server-side.

Matches whole words in task titles and content, case-insensitively
("quokka" finds "Quokka plan", "quok" does not). Faster than listing every
project and scanning. For criteria without a keyword (priority, date range,
kind), use filter_tasks.

projects.description: Only search these projects (names or IDs; "inbox" works).

tools.name: filter_tasks
tools.description:
Filter tasks by project, date range, priority, tags, status, or kind, server-side.

All criteria are optional and combine. No keyword matching; use search_tasks
for that. Not related to the saved filters (list_filters and friends).

projects.description: Only these projects (names or IDs; "inbox" works).

end_date.description: Latest task start date, same formats.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description:
List all tags.

Returns all tags with their names, colors, parent relationships, and sort settings.

tools.name: add_tags
tools.description: Create one or more new tags.

names.description: List of tag names to create.

tools.name: delete_tags
tools.description:
Delete one or more tags by name.

Tasks keep existing, but the tag is removed from every task that had it.

names.description: List of tag names to delete.

tools.name: rename_tag
tools.description:
Rename a tag.

All tasks with the old tag name will be updated to use the new name.

tools.name: edit_tag
tools.description:
Update a tag's properties.

Only provided fields are changed.

parent.description: Set a parent tag name (for hierarchical tags).

clear_parent.description: Set to true to remove the parent tag.

tools.name: merge_tags
tools.description:
Merge a source tag into a target tag.

All tasks tagged with the source tag will be re-tagged with the target tag.
The source tag is deleted.

source.description: Tag name to merge from (will be deleted).

target.description: Tag name to merge into (will be kept).

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description:
List all project folders (groups).

Folders organize projects into groups. Returns folder IDs, names,
and sort settings.

tools.name: add_folder
tools.description: Create a new project folder.

tools.name: delete_folders
tools.description:
Delete one or more folders.

Projects inside deleted folders are not deleted — they become ungrouped.

folders.description: List of folder names or IDs to delete. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: rename_folder
tools.description: Rename a project folder.

folder.description: Current folder name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: list_habits
tools.description:
List all habits.

Returns all habits with their IDs, names, types, goals, streaks, and sections.
Requires v2 session token.

tools.name: add_habit
tools.description: Create a new habit.

habit_type.description: "Boolean" for yes/no, "Numeric" for tracked values. Default: "Boolean".

goal.description: Daily goal value (e.g. 8 for "8 glasses of water"). Default: 1 for Boolean.

section.description: Habit section name or ID to group this habit under.

repeat_rule.description: Repeat rule string (e.g. for specific days of the week).

tools.name: edit_habit
tools.description:
Update an existing habit's properties.

Only provided fields are changed.

habit.description: Habit name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

section.description: Move to this section (name or ID).

tools.name: delete_habits
tools.description: Delete one or more habits.

habits.description: List of habit names or IDs to delete. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: checkin_habit
tools.description:
Record a habit check-in for a given date.

For Boolean habits, value=1 means done. For Numeric habits, value is the
tracked amount (e.g. 3 for "3 glasses of water").

habit.description: Habit name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

value.description: Check-in value. Default: 1.0 (done for Boolean habits).

tools.name: habit_log
tools.description: Query check-in history for one or more habits.

habits.description: List of habit names or IDs to query. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: archive_habits
tools.description:
Archive one or more habits (set status to inactive).

Archived habits are hidden from the main view but retain their data.

habits.description: List of habit names or IDs to archive. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: manage_habit_sections
tools.description:
Manage habit sections (groups for organizing habits).

Consolidates list/add/delete/rename operations into one tool.

sections.description: List of section names or IDs (required for "delete").

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description:
List all saved filters.

Returns all custom filters with their IDs, names, rules, and sort settings.
Requires v2 session token.

tools.name: add_filter
tools.description: Create a new saved filter.

tools.name: edit_filter
tools.description:
Update an existing filter.

Only provided fields are changed.

filter_name.description: Current filter name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: delete_filters
tools.description: Delete one or more saved filters.

filters.description: List of filter names or IDs to delete. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: focus_status
tools.description:
Get the current focus/pomodoro timer status.

Returns the active timer state including elapsed time, task association,
and whether it's running or paused. Requires v2 session token.

tools.name: focus_stats
tools.description:
Get focus/pomodoro statistics.

Returns daily and total focus time statistics including session counts
and total minutes. Requires v2 session token.

Note: "total" fields may exclude the current day (TickTick caches these).
Use focus_log for accurate current-day data.

tools.name: focus_log
tools.description: Get focus session log for a date range.

tools.name: focus_timeline
tools.description:
Get the full focus session timeline.

Returns all focus sessions in chronological order.
Requires v2 session token.

tools.name: focus_save
tools.description:
Save a completed focus/pomodoro record.

Records a focus session that has already happened. This does not start
a live timer — it saves a historical record.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the focus session in minutes. Must be >= 1.

end.description: End time: "now" (default) or ISO datetime string (e.g. "2026-02-22T14:30:00").

note.description: Optional note to attach to the session.

task_id.description: Optional task ID to associate with the session.

project_id.description: Optional project ID (required if task_id is provided).

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description:
List third-party calendar accounts connected to TickTick.

Returns connected calendar accounts (Google Calendar, Outlook, etc.)
with their sync status. Requires v2 session token.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description:
Query calendar events for a date range.

Returns events from all connected calendars within the specified date range.

tools.name: sync_account
tools.description:
Perform a full account sync.

Fetches the complete account state including all projects, tasks, tags,
filters, folders, and settings. Useful for getting a comprehensive view
of the account or forcing a refresh. Requires v2 session token.

tools.name: list_columns
tools.description:
List the kanban columns of a project.

Returns column IDs, names, colors, and sort orders. A project only has
columns when it uses the kanban view.

project.description: Project name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

tools.name: add_column
tools.description: Create a kanban column in a project.

project.description: Project name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

sort_order.description: Position among the columns; lower comes first.

color.description: Column color as a hex string, e.g. "#FF0000".

tools.name: edit_column
tools.description:
Rename, reorder, or recolor a kanban column.

Only provided fields are changed. The official API has no endpoint to
delete a column, so there is no delete_column tool.

project.description: Project name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

column.description: Column name or ID. Supports fuzzy matching.

sort_order.description: New position among the columns; lower comes first.

color.description: New color as a hex string, e.g. "#FF0000".

tools.name: list_countdowns
tools.description:
List all countdowns (birthdays, anniversaries, events).

Read-only: the official API has no create, update, or delete for countdowns.
Each countdown has an id, name, date (YYYYMMDD integer), repeatFlag, reminders,
and display settings.

resources.name: profile
resources.description: User profile and subscription status merged into one view.

resources.name: settings
resources.description: User preference settings including web-specific options.

resources.name: projects
resources.description: All projects (task lists) with their IDs, names, colors, and folder assignments.

resources.name: tags
resources.description: All tags with their names, colors, and hierarchical relationships.
